name: The Dream of the Blue Turtles

info.desc: The Dream of the Blue Turtles is the first solo album released by Sting. It includes ten tracks and was released in 1985, only a year after The Police had unofficially broken up. This album showcases Sting's abilities as a musician in the jazz and classical genres. There are also hints of Sting wanting fans to view him as more than just a member of The Police, as evidenced by the intentional and sudden contrast of musical style from his former band. podcast.body: Released in 1985, this album marked a significant departure from The Police's sound for many fans, but for Sting, it was a return to his jazz roots in Newcastle. He assembled a band of seasoned jazz players for the project. The album rose to number two on the album chart, solidifying Sting as a solo act, and eventually went double platinum and then triple platinum. Its title was inspired by a dream Sting had about blue turtles. "To Sting himself, it was a return to his roots as a jazz player in Newcastle."
